cards.title: Tags that say what they are
cards.body: `<header>`, `<main>` and `<footer>` look like plain boxes, but they tell browsers and screen readers which part of the page is which.

cards.title: Tags inside tags
cards.body: Tags can hold other tags. Indent the inner ones so you can see the structure at a glance.

check.question: Which tag holds the page's main content?
check.explanation: `<main>` is the main content. The header comes before it and the footer after it.

exercise.prompt: Give your page a `<header>` with an `<h1>` inside, a `<main>` with a paragraph inside, and a `<footer>`.
